```{r}
# Step 1: inner_join to get only participants with BOTH species + metadata (~800)
combined <- metadata_diabete %>%
  mutate(
    BMI = DBI14_Weight / (DBI13_Height / 100)^2,
    BMI_category = case_when(
      BMI < 18.5                ~ "Underweight",
      BMI >= 18.5 & BMI < 23   ~ "Normal",
      BMI >= 23   & BMI < 27.5 ~ "Overweight",
      BMI >= 27.5               ~ "Obese",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    diabetes_status = case_when(
      DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent < 5.7                               ~ "Normal",
      DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent >= 5.7 & DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent < 6.5 ~ "Prediabetic",
      DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent >= 6.5                              ~ "Diabetic",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    BMI_category    = factor(BMI_category, levels = c("Underweight", "Normal", "Overweight", "Obese")),
    diabetes_status = factor(diabetes_status, levels = c("Normal", "Prediabetic", "Diabetic"))
  ) %>%
  inner_join(species_filtered1, by = "FREG1_Barcode")  # only matched samples

cat("Total matched samples:", nrow(combined), "\n")
table(combined$BMI_category, useNA = "ifany")
table(combined$diabetes_status, useNA = "ifany")
```

## beta diversity with aitchson
```{r}
library(zCompositions)
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

## --- 1. Clean count matrix (samples x species), aligned to metadata ---
sp_cols <- base::setdiff(colnames(species_filtered1), "FREG1_Barcode")

mat <- combined %>%
  dplyr::select(FREG1_Barcode, all_of(sp_cols)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  as.matrix()

# sanity: counts vs proportions?
cat("max value:", max(mat), "| looks like",
    ifelse(max(mat) > 1.5, "COUNTS", "PROPORTIONS"), "\n")
cat("dim:", nrow(mat), "samples x", ncol(mat), "species\n")

## --- 2. Zero replacement + CLR  (= Aitchison geometry) ----------------
# CZM = Bayesian-multiplicative replacement for count zeros
mat_repl <- cmultRepl(mat, label = 0, method = "CZM",
                      z.warning = 0.99, z.delete = FALSE)
clr_mat  <- t(apply(mat_repl, 1, function(x) log(x) - mean(log(x))))
#  (if your data are PROPORTIONS not counts, tell me — swap CZM for a
#   pseudocount approach; CLR itself is scale-invariant so the rest holds)

## --- 3. Metadata aligned + complete cases for covariates --------------

meta <- combined %>%
  mutate(FREG5_Ethnic_Group = factor(FREG5_Ethnic_Group),
         FREG7_Gender       = factor(FREG7_Gender),
         FREG8_Age          = as.numeric(FREG8_Age),
         HbA1c              = as.numeric(DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent)) %>%
  filter(FREG1_Barcode %in% rownames(clr_mat))
meta <- meta[match(rownames(clr_mat), meta$FREG1_Barcode), ]   # same order

## drop "Others" ethnicity, keep C/I/M only
keep_eth <- meta$FREG5_Ethnic_Group %in% c("C", "I", "M")
clr_mat <- clr_mat[keep_eth, ]
meta     <- meta[keep_eth, ]
meta$FREG5_Ethnic_Group <- droplevels(factor(meta$FREG5_Ethnic_Group))
cat("after dropping Others:", nrow(meta), "samples |",
    paste(levels(meta$FREG5_Ethnic_Group), collapse = "/"), "\n")

stopifnot(all(meta$FREG1_Barcode == rownames(clr_mat)))

keep <- complete.cases(meta[, c("FREG5_Ethnic_Group","FREG7_Gender",
                                "FREG8_Age","BMI","HbA1c")])
clr_cc  <- clr_mat[keep, ]
meta_cc <- meta[keep, ]
cat("complete-case n:", nrow(meta_cc), "\n")
```


```{r}
## --- 4. Aitchison PERMANOVA (primary: ethnicity, adjusted) ------------
aitchison <- dist(clr_cc, method = "euclidean")

set.seed(123)
adonis2(aitchison ~ FREG5_Ethnic_Group + FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + HbA1c,
        data = meta_cc, by = "margin", permutations = 100)

## --- 5. Bray-Curtis on the SAME samples (rebuild from filtered set) ---
common <- rownames(clr_cc)
rel    <- mat_repl[common, ] / rowSums(mat_repl[common, ])
set.seed(123)
adonis2(vegdist(rel, "bray") ~ FREG5_Ethnic_Group + FREG8_Age +
          FREG7_Gender + BMI + HbA1c,
        data = meta_cc, by = "margin", permutations = 100)
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

## --- CLR-PCA = Aitchison ordination (compositional analog of PCoA) ---
pca <- prcomp(clr_cc)                         # features auto-centered
ve  <- round(100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), 1)   # % variance per PC

# map ethnicity codes -> labels (check codes first if unsure: table(meta_cc$FREG5_Ethnic_Group))
eth_lab <- c(C = "Chinese", I = "Indian", M = "Malay")
pal     <- c(Chinese = "#9FDDCA", Indian = "#9EA3F1",Malay   = "#E17887")
#ethnicity_colors <- c("C" = "#9FDDCA", "I" = "#9EA3F1", "M" = "#E17887", "O" = "#80796BFF")

pca_df <- data.frame(PC1 = pca$x[, 1], PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
                     ethnic = factor(eth_lab[as.character(meta_cc$FREG5_Ethnic_Group)]))

p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = ethnic)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 1.5) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.8) +     # 0.68 for tighter ellipses
  scale_color_manual(values = pal) +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", ve[1]),
       y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", ve[2]),
       color = NULL,
       title = "Aitchison PCA (CLR-transformed) by ethnicity") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

#ggsave("figure/aitchison_pca.pdf", p_pca, width = 6.5, height = 5.5)
p_pca
```

#diet pc for comment 5
```{r}
## --- Build diet PCs from the FFQ items -------------------------------
diet_raw <- food_data %>% mutate(FREG1_Barcode = as.character(Participant_ID))

food_cols <- diet_raw %>% dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>% colnames()
cat("numeric food columns:", length(food_cols), "\n")   # sanity-check this count

diet_mat <- diet_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(FREG1_Barcode %in% meta_cc$FREG1_Barcode) %>%
  dplyr::select(FREG1_Barcode, all_of(food_cols)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  as.matrix()

# median-impute sparse NAs, drop zero-variance items (prcomp scale needs sd>0)
for (j in seq_len(ncol(diet_mat))) {
  v <- diet_mat[, j]; v[is.na(v)] <- median(v, na.rm = TRUE); diet_mat[, j] <- v
}
diet_mat <- diet_mat[, apply(diet_mat, 2, sd) > 0]

diet_pca <- prcomp(diet_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
print(round(summary(diet_pca)$importance[2, 1:6], 3))   # variance per diet PC

diet_pcs <- as.data.frame(diet_pca$x[, 1:4])
colnames(diet_pcs) <- paste0("diet_PC", 1:4)
diet_pcs$FREG1_Barcode <- rownames(diet_pcs)

## --- Combined multivariable PERMANOVA on Aitchison -------------------
model_df <- meta_cc %>% inner_join(diet_pcs, by = "FREG1_Barcode")

terms_needed <- c("FREG5_Ethnic_Group","FREG8_Age","FREG7_Gender","BMI","HbA1c",
                  paste0("diet_PC", 1:4))
model_df <- model_df[complete.cases(model_df[, terms_needed]), ]

clr_sub <- clr_cc[match(model_df$FREG1_Barcode, rownames(clr_cc)), ]
stopifnot(all(rownames(clr_sub) == model_df$FREG1_Barcode))
cat("samples in combined model:", nrow(clr_sub), "\n")

set.seed(123)
adonis2(dist(clr_sub) ~ FREG5_Ethnic_Group + diet_PC1 + diet_PC2 + diet_PC3 + diet_PC4 +
          FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + HbA1c,
        data = model_df, by = "margin", permutations = 100)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2); library(dplyr)

# rerun storing the result if you didn't keep it
set.seed(123)
res5 <- adonis2(dist(clr_sub) ~ FREG5_Ethnic_Group + diet_PC1 + diet_PC2 +
                  diet_PC3 + diet_PC4 + FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + HbA1c,
                data = model_df, by = "margin", permutations = 100)

r2_df <- as.data.frame(res5) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  filter(!term %in% c("Residual", "Total")) %>%
  mutate(
    label = recode(term,
      FREG5_Ethnic_Group = "Ethnicity", FREG8_Age = "Age",
      FREG7_Gender = "Sex", BMI = "BMI", HbA1c = "HbA1c",
      diet_PC1 = "Diet PC1", diet_PC2 = "Diet PC2",
      diet_PC3 = "Diet PC3", diet_PC4 = "Diet PC4"),
    sig = ifelse(`Pr(>F)` < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "ns")) %>%
  arrange(R2)

p_var <- ggplot(r2_df, aes(reorder(label, R2), R2 * 100, fill = sig)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f%%", R2 * 100)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("p < 0.05" = "#D55E00", "ns" = "grey75")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Variance explained (% of total, Aitchison)",
       fill = NULL,
       title = "Host and dietary contributions to microbiome composition",
       subtitle = "Multivariable PERMANOVA, marginal (adjusted) effects, n = 856") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

## change deseq2 to linda
```{r}
library(MicrobiomeStat)

## --- Count matrix (features x samples) + metadata, C/I/M only -------
sp_cols <- base::setdiff(colnames(species_filtered1), "FREG1_Barcode")  # redefine if needed

cim <- combined %>%
  mutate(FREG5_Ethnic_Group = factor(FREG5_Ethnic_Group),
         FREG7_Gender = factor(FREG7_Gender),
         FREG8_Age    = as.numeric(FREG8_Age),
         HbA1c        = as.numeric(DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent)) %>%
  filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group %in% c("C","I","M"),
         !is.na(FREG8_Age), !is.na(FREG7_Gender), !is.na(BMI), !is.na(HbA1c)) %>%
  droplevels()

feat_mat <- cim %>%
  dplyr::select(FREG1_Barcode, all_of(sp_cols)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  as.matrix() %>% t()                         # rows = species, cols = barcodes

meta_da <- cim %>% as.data.frame() %>% column_to_rownames("FREG1_Barcode")
stopifnot(all(colnames(feat_mat) == rownames(meta_da)))
cat("DA cohort:", ncol(feat_mat), "samples x", nrow(feat_mat), "species\n")

## --- One-vs-rest LinDA per ethnicity, adjusted ---------------------
run_linda_ovr <- function(grp) {
  md <- meta_da
  md$grp <- factor(ifelse(md$FREG5_Ethnic_Group == grp, grp, "Other"),
                   levels = c("Other", grp))   # grp = the contrast level
  fit <- linda(feature.dat = feat_mat, meta.dat = md,
               formula = "~ grp + FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + HbA1c",
               feature.dat.type = "count",
               prev.filter = 0.10, is.winsor = TRUE)
  res <- fit$output[[paste0("grp", grp)]]
  res$feature    <- rownames(res)
  res$comparison <- paste0(grp, " vs rest")
  res
}

linda_all <- lapply(c("C","I","M"), run_linda_ovr)
names(linda_all) <- c("C","I","M")

## --- Significant-hit counts per comparison -------------------------
sapply(linda_all, function(x) sum(x$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE))

## --- Bifidobacterium results across the three ----------------------
bifido_da <- do.call(rbind, lapply(linda_all, function(x)
  x[grepl("Bifidobacterium", x$feature, ignore.case = TRUE), ])) %>%
  dplyr::select(comparison, feature, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj) %>%
  arrange(comparison, padj)

# significant Bifido only:
bifido_da %>% filter(padj < 0.05)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2); library(dplyr)

N_TOP <- 30   # change to 25 if panels feel crowded

lolli_sig <- function(comp_code, title_grp, n_top = N_TOP) {
  df <- linda_all[[comp_code]] %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
    slice_min(padj, n = n_top, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      # shorten genus names for readability: "Bifidobacterium longum" -> "B. longum"
      #feature = gsub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", feature),
      direction = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "Enriched", "Depleted"),
      feature = reorder(feature, log2FoldChange))

  n_sig <- sum(linda_all[[comp_code]]$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  subtitle <- sprintf("LinDA, adj. age/sex/BMI/HbA1c | %d significant; top %d shown",
                      n_sig, nrow(df))

  ggplot(df, aes(log2FoldChange, feature, color = direction)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = log2FoldChange, yend = feature), linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(size = pmin(-log10(padj), 10))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Enriched" = "#D55E00", "Depleted" = "#0072B2"),
                       drop = FALSE) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.8, 5), name = "-log10(padj)") +
    labs(x = "log2 fold-change (adjusted)", y = NULL, color = NULL,
         title = paste0(title_grp, " vs rest"), subtitle = subtitle) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5))   # smaller for ~30 labels
}

p_C <- lolli_sig("C", "Chinese")
p_I <- lolli_sig("I", "Indian")
p_M <- lolli_sig("M", "Malay")

# height scales with how many species each panel shows
h <- function(p) max(4, 0.22 * nrow(p$data) + 1.5)
ggsave("figure/linda_lollipop_chinese.pdf", p_C, width = 8, height = h(p_C))
ggsave("figure/linda_lollipop_indian.pdf",  p_I, width = 8, height = h(p_I))
ggsave("figure/linda_lollipop_malay.pdf",   p_M, width = 8, height = h(p_M))
p_C; p_I; p_M
```
# maaslin2
```{r}
library(Maaslin2)

run_maaslin_ovr <- function(grp) {
  md <- meta_da
  md$grp <- factor(ifelse(md$FREG5_Ethnic_Group == grp, grp, "Other"),
                   levels = c("Other", grp))   # Other = reference

  fit <- Maaslin2(
    input_data     = as.data.frame(t(feat_mat)),   # MaAsLin wants samples x features
    input_metadata = md,
    output          = paste0("maaslin_", grp),
    fixed_effects   = c("grp", "FREG8_Age", "FREG7_Gender", "BMI", "HbA1c"),
    reference       = c("grp,Other"),
    normalization   = "TSS",
    transform       = "LOG",
    min_prevalence  = 0.10,
    plot_heatmap    = FALSE, plot_scatter = FALSE)

  res <- fit$results %>%
    filter(metadata == "grp") %>%
    transmute(feature = gsub("\\.", " ", feature),   # MaAsLin sanitizes names
              coef_maaslin = coef, qval_maaslin = qval,
              comparison = paste0(grp, " vs rest"))
  res
}

maaslin_all <- lapply(c("C","I","M"), run_maaslin_ovr)
names(maaslin_all) <- c("C","I","M")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

concord <- function(grp) {
  l <- linda_all[[grp]] %>%
    transmute(feature, linda_l2fc = log2FoldChange, linda_padj = padj)
  m <- maaslin_all[[grp]] %>%
    transmute(feature, maaslin_coef = coef_maaslin, maaslin_qval = qval_maaslin)
  inner_join(l, m, by = "feature") %>%
    mutate(both_sig = linda_padj < 0.05 & maaslin_qval < 0.05,
           same_dir = sign(linda_l2fc) == sign(maaslin_coef),
           comparison = paste0(grp, " vs rest"))
}

concord_all <- bind_rows(lapply(c("C","I","M"), concord))

# headline numbers for the response:
concord_all %>%
  filter(linda_padj < 0.05 & maaslin_qval < 0.05) %>%   # significant in both
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    n_both    = n(),
    n_agree   = sum(sign(linda_l2fc) == sign(maaslin_coef)),
    agree_pct = round(100 * n_agree / n_both, 1),
    .groups = "drop")

# Bifido specifically, both methods:
concord_all %>% filter(grepl("Bifidobacterium", feature), both_sig)
```
```{r}

N_TOP <- 30

lolli_maaslin <- function(grp, title_grp, n_top = N_TOP) {

    filter(qval_maaslin < 0.05) %>%
    slice_min(qval_maaslin, n = n_top, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      #feature   = gsub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", feature),
      direction = ifelse(coef_maaslin > 0, "Enriched", "Depleted"),
      feature   = reorder(feature, coef_maaslin))

  n_sig <- sum(maaslin_all[[grp]]$qval_maaslin < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

  ggplot(d, aes(coef_maaslin, feature, color = direction)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = coef_maaslin, yend = feature), linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(size = pmin(-log10(qval_maaslin), 10))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Enriched" = "#D55E00", "Depleted" = "#0072B2"),
                       drop = FALSE) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.8, 5), name = "-log10(qval)") +
    labs(x = "MaAsLin2 coefficient (adjusted)", y = NULL, color = NULL,
         title = paste0(title_grp, " vs rest"),
         subtitle = sprintf("MaAsLin2, adj. age/sex/BMI/HbA1c | %d significant; top %d shown",
                            n_sig, nrow(d))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5))
}
```

## ancom-bc2
```{r}
# ANCOM-BC2
library(ANCOMBC)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

## ANCOM-BC2 uses natural-log fold change, not log2FC.
## Here we keep the same data/covariates as LinDA and MaAsLin2.

run_ancombc2_ovr <- function(grp) {
  md <- meta_da
  
  md$grp <- factor(
    ifelse(md$FREG5_Ethnic_Group == grp, grp, "Other"),
    levels = c("Other", grp)
  )
  
  # ANCOM-BC2 needs counts: features x samples
  count_dat <- round(feat_mat)
  mode(count_dat) <- "integer"
  
  # Remove samples with zero total counts, just in case
  keep_samp <- colSums(count_dat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  count_dat <- count_dat[, keep_samp]
  md <- md[colnames(count_dat), , drop = FALSE]
  
  stopifnot(all(colnames(count_dat) == rownames(md)))
  
  set.seed(123)
  fit <- ancombc2(
    data = count_dat,
    aggregate_data = count_dat,
    meta_data = md,
    fix_formula = "grp + FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + HbA1c",
    rand_formula = NULL,
    p_adj_method = "BH",
    pseudo_sens = FALSE,   # much faster
    prv_cut = 0.40,
    lib_cut = 0,
    s0_perc = 0.05,
    group = "grp",
    struc_zero = FALSE,    # faster
    neg_lb = FALSE,        # faster
    alpha = 0.05,
    n_cl = 3,              # increase if your laptop can handle it
    verbose = TRUE,
    global = FALSE,
    pairwise = FALSE,
    dunnet = FALSE,
    trend = FALSE,
    iter_control = list(tol = 1e-4, max_iter = 20, verbose = FALSE),
    em_control = list(tol = 1e-4, max_iter = 50),
    lme_control = NULL,
    mdfdr_control = list(fwer_ctrl_method = "BH", B = 100),
    trend_control = NULL
    )
  
  res <- fit$res
  
  # Column names are usually like:
  # lfc_grpI, se_grpI, W_grpI, p_grpI, q_grpI, diff_grpI, passed_ss_grpI
  effect_name <- paste0("grp", grp)
  
  out <- res %>%
    transmute(
      feature = taxon,
      lfc_ancombc2 = .data[[paste0("lfc_", effect_name)]],
      se_ancombc2 = .data[[paste0("se_", effect_name)]],
      W_ancombc2 = .data[[paste0("W_", effect_name)]],
      p_ancombc2 = .data[[paste0("p_", effect_name)]],
      q_ancombc2 = .data[[paste0("q_", effect_name)]],
      diff_ancombc2 = .data[[paste0("diff_", effect_name)]],
      passed_ss_ancombc2 = if (paste0("passed_ss_", effect_name) %in% colnames(res)) {
        .data[[paste0("passed_ss_", effect_name)]]
      } else {
        NA
      },
      comparison = paste0(grp, " vs rest")
    )
  
  return(out)
}

ancombc2_all <- lapply(c("C", "I", "M"), run_ancombc2_ovr)
names(ancombc2_all) <- c("C", "I", "M")
```

```{r}
N_TOP <- 30

lolli_ancombc2 <- function(grp, title_grp, n_top = N_TOP) {
  d <- ancombc2_all[[grp]] %>%
    filter(q_ancombc2 < 0.05) %>%
    slice_min(q_ancombc2, n = n_top, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = ifelse(lfc_ancombc2 > 0, "Enriched", "Depleted"),
      feature = reorder(feature, lfc_ancombc2)
    )
  
  n_sig <- sum(ancombc2_all[[grp]]$q_ancombc2 < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ggplot(d, aes(lfc_ancombc2, feature, color = direction)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = lfc_ancombc2, yend = feature), linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(size = pmin(-log10(q_ancombc2), 10))) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Enriched" = "#D55E00", "Depleted" = "#0072B2"),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.8, 5), name = "-log10(q)") +
    labs(
      x = "ANCOM-BC2 log fold-change, natural log scale",
      y = NULL,
      color = NULL,
      title = paste0(title_grp, " vs rest"),
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "ANCOM-BC2, adj. age/sex/BMI/HbA1c | %d significant; top %d shown",
        n_sig, nrow(d)
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5)
    )
}

ap_C <- lolli_ancombc2("C", "Chinese")

ap_M <- lolli_ancombc2("M", "Malay")
```

## ancombc2, linda, maaslin2
```{r}
concord3 <- function(grp) {
  l <- linda_all[[grp]] %>%
    transmute(
      feature,
      linda_l2fc = log2FoldChange,
      linda_padj = padj
    )
  
  m <- maaslin_all[[grp]] %>%
    transmute(
      feature,
      maaslin_coef = coef_maaslin,
      maaslin_qval = qval_maaslin
    )
  
  a <- ancombc2_all[[grp]] %>%
    transmute(
      feature,
      ancombc2_lfc = lfc_ancombc2,
      ancombc2_q = q_ancombc2,
      ancombc2_passed_ss = passed_ss_ancombc2
    )
  
  l %>%
    inner_join(m, by = "feature") %>%
    inner_join(a, by = "feature") %>%
    mutate(
      sig_linda = linda_padj < 0.05,
      sig_maaslin = maaslin_qval < 0.05,
      sig_ancombc2 = ancombc2_q < 0.05,
      sig_all3 = sig_linda & sig_maaslin & sig_ancombc2,
      same_dir_all3 =
        sign(linda_l2fc) == sign(maaslin_coef) &
        sign(linda_l2fc) == sign(ancombc2_lfc),
      comparison = paste0(grp, " vs rest")
    )
}

concord3_all <- bind_rows(lapply(c("C", "I", "M"), concord3))

# headline numbers
concord3_all %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    n_linda = sum(sig_linda, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_maaslin = sum(sig_maaslin, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ancombc2 = sum(sig_ancombc2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_all3 = sum(sig_all3, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_all3_same_direction = sum(sig_all3 & same_dir_all3, na.rm = TRUE),
    agree_pct_among_all3 = round(
      100 * n_all3_same_direction / n_all3, 1
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Bifidobacterium concordance
concord3_all %>%
  filter(grepl("Bifidobacterium", feature, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(comparison, ancombc2_q)
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Reviewer 2: Aitchison analysis for rebuttal
## No table files saved.
## Figures saved only.
############################################################

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(vegan)
library(zCompositions)
library(ggplot2)

dir.create("figure", showWarnings = FALSE)

############################################################
## 1. Load data
############################################################

food_data <- read_xlsx("data/FFQA862_new.xlsx")
species <- read_xlsx("data/species_866.xlsx")
metadata_diabete <- read_xlsx("data/helios800_diabetes.xlsx")

species <- species %>%
  mutate(FREG1_Barcode = as.character(FREG1_Barcode))

metadata_diabete <- metadata_diabete %>%
  mutate(FREG1_Barcode = as.character(FREG1_Barcode))

food_data <- food_data %>%
  mutate(Participant_ID = as.character(Participant_ID))

############################################################
## 2. Filter species
############################################################

species_filtered <- species %>%
  select_if(function(x) {
    if (is.numeric(x)) {
      sum(x > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > nrow(species) * 0.2
    } else {
      TRUE
    }
  })

species_filtered <- species_filtered[, !names(species_filtered) %in%
                                       c("unclassified", "others", "Homo sapiens")]
```


```{r}
sp_cols <- base::setdiff(colnames(species_filtered), "FREG1_Barcode")

cat("\nNumber of retained species:", length(sp_cols), "\n")

############################################################
## 3. Build metadata + microbiome matrix
############################################################

combined <- metadata_diabete %>%
  mutate(
    BMI = DBI14_Weight / (DBI13_Height / 100)^2,
    HbA1c = as.numeric(DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent),
    FREG8_Age = as.numeric(FREG8_Age),
    FREG5_Ethnic_Group = factor(FREG5_Ethnic_Group),
    FREG7_Gender = factor(FREG7_Gender)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(species_filtered, by = "FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group %in% c("C", "I", "M")) %>%
  droplevels()

cat("\nSamples after keeping Chinese, Indian, Malay only:\n")
print(table(combined$FREG5_Ethnic_Group))

mat <- combined %>%
  select(FREG1_Barcode, all_of(sp_cols)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"

cat("\nMicrobiome matrix:", nrow(mat), "samples x", ncol(mat), "species\n")
cat("Maximum value in matrix:", max(mat, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

############################################################
## 4. Zero replacement + CLR transformation
############################################################

mat_repl <- cmultRepl(
  mat,
  label = 0,
  method = "CZM",
  z.warning = 0.99,
  z.delete = FALSE
)

clr_mat <- t(apply(mat_repl, 1, function(x) {
  log(x) - mean(log(x))
}))

############################################################
## 5. Align metadata and complete cases
############################################################

meta <- combined %>%
  select(FREG1_Barcode, FREG5_Ethnic_Group, FREG7_Gender,
         FREG8_Age, BMI, HbA1c)

meta <- meta[match(rownames(clr_mat), meta$FREG1_Barcode), ]

stopifnot(all(meta$FREG1_Barcode == rownames(clr_mat)))

keep <- complete.cases(meta[, c("FREG5_Ethnic_Group", "FREG7_Gender",
                                "FREG8_Age", "BMI", "HbA1c")])

clr_cc <- clr_mat[keep, ]
meta_cc <- meta[keep, ]

cat("\nComplete-case samples for Aitchison PERMANOVA:", nrow(meta_cc), "\n")
print(table(meta_cc$FREG5_Ethnic_Group))
```


```{r}
############################################################
## 6. Aitchison PERMANOVA: ethnicity adjusted for covariates
############################################################

aitchison_dist <- dist(clr_cc, method = "euclidean")

set.seed(123)
conflicts_prefer(car::recode)
conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)
perm_aitchison <- adonis2(
  aitchison_dist ~ FREG5_Ethnic_Group + FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + HbA1c,
  data = meta_cc,
  by = "margin",
  permutations = 100
)

perm_aitchison_df <- as.data.frame(perm_aitchison) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  mutate(
    R2_percent = R2 * 100,
    p_value = `Pr(>F)`
  )

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("1. Adjusted Aitchison PERMANOVA\n")
cat("Model: Aitchison distance ~ ethnicity + age + sex + BMI + HbA1c\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
print(perm_aitchison_df)
```


```{r}
############################################################
## 7. Bray-Curtis sensitivity on the same samples
############################################################

common_samples <- rownames(clr_cc)

rel_abund <- mat_repl[common_samples, ]
rel_abund <- rel_abund / rowSums(rel_abund)

set.seed(123)
perm_bray <- adonis2(
  vegdist(rel_abund, method = "bray") ~
    FREG5_Ethnic_Group + FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI + HbA1c,
  data = meta_cc,
  by = "margin",
  permutations = 100
)

perm_bray_df <- as.data.frame(perm_bray) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  mutate(
    R2_percent = R2 * 100,
    p_value = `Pr(>F)`
  )

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("2. Bray-Curtis PERMANOVA sensitivity analysis on same samples\n")
cat("Model: Bray-Curtis distance ~ ethnicity + age + sex + BMI + HbA1c\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
print(perm_bray_df)
```

```{r}
############################################################
## 10. Diet PCs
############################################################

diet_raw <- food_data %>%
  mutate(FREG1_Barcode = Participant_ID)

food_cols <- diet_raw %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  colnames()

cat("\nNumber of numeric food variables used for diet PCA:", length(food_cols), "\n")

diet_mat <- diet_raw %>%
  filter(FREG1_Barcode %in% meta_cc$FREG1_Barcode) %>%
  select(FREG1_Barcode, all_of(food_cols)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("FREG1_Barcode") %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(diet_mat) <- "numeric"

for (j in seq_len(ncol(diet_mat))) {
  v <- diet_mat[, j]
  v[is.na(v)] <- median(v, na.rm = TRUE)
  diet_mat[, j] <- v
}

diet_mat <- diet_mat[, apply(diet_mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0]

cat("Number of food variables after removing zero-variance items:", ncol(diet_mat), "\n")

diet_pca <- prcomp(diet_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

diet_var <- summary(diet_pca)$importance[2, ]

cat("\n============================================================\n")

cat("============================================================\n")
print(round(diet_var[1:10] * 100, 2))

diet_pcs <- as.data.frame(diet_pca$x[, 1:4])
colnames(diet_pcs) <- paste0("diet_PC", 1:4)
diet_pcs$FREG1_Barcode <- rownames(diet_pcs)
```

```{r}
############################################################

model_df <- meta_cc %>%
  inner_join(diet_pcs, by = "FREG1_Barcode")

terms_needed <- c(
```

```{r}
extract_term <- function(df, term) {
  out <- df %>% filter(Variable == term)
  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(NULL)
  data.frame(
    Variable = out$Variable,
    R2_percent = round(out$R2_percent, 3),
    F_value = round(out$F, 3),
    p_value = out$p_value
  )
}

eth_adj <- extract_term(perm_aitchison_df, "FREG5_Ethnic_Group")
```
